hero.title: Edeiver Barranco

about.title: Systems Engineer turned product-focused developer
about.body: I'm a Front-End and Mobile Developer with 7+ years of experience shipping production apps in fintech, payments and crypto. I've led mobile development for payment platforms, built white-label apps adapted to different brands, integrated crypto and payment rails, and taken a national-scale Bitcoin wallet from zero to its first release. I care about reliable releases, clean handoffs with backend teams, and interfaces that feel effortless.

points: Led mobile development for payment applications, white-label solutions and products involving cryptocurrency functionality.
Built and maintained Cobru and white-label mobile apps, adapting the product to different brands and business requirements.
Implemented payment and crypto integrations, guiding client companies through technical integration requirements.
Managed app releases and store deployments, coordinating with backend teams on production issues across payment and digital-asset flows.
Developed and maintained front-end and mobile applications with React, React Native, Expo and JavaScript.
Worked closely with backend teams to integrate features end-to-end, deployed releases and provided ongoing production support.

items.role: Front-End Developer (Client project via Trixel S.A.S.) · San Salvador, El Salvador
points: Engaged to build the first version of a Bitcoin wallet application for the Government of El Salvador, as part of the country's national Bitcoin adoption initiative.
Developed the app's front-end and mobile functionality with React Native, Expo and React, coordinating with the backend team end-to-end and providing ongoing support.
Developed web interfaces and web-based software functionality using JavaScript and React.

centauri.name: Centauri
centauri.tagline: Full-stack fintech app with AI insights
centauri.description: A personal expense tracker I built end-to-end: a React Native/Expo client backed by a Node/Express/PostgreSQL API I wrote and deployed myself. It tracks income and expenses, visualizes spending as a 'planetary' system, and periodically calls an LLM to turn recent transactions into plain-language insights, recommendations and warnings — a real, cached AI feature, not a static screen.
features: AI-generated spending insights (Groq) surfaced as a narrative hero card, cached 6h server-side per language
JWT auth with refresh-token rotation, hashed refresh tokens and silent background renewal
Spending-goal / budget cycles: set an amount and duration, get re-prompted, notified when a cycle ends
Month-over-month expense trend computed client-side from already-fetched transactions
Multi-language (English/Spanish) including the AI insight text itself
USD/COP currency toggle and persisted dark/light theme
Self-built backend with parameterized SQL, bcrypt-hashed passwords and a small test suite
Native share sheet for AI insights

pasameApp.name: Pásame
pasameApp.description: A fully functional React Native/Expo fintech app: a premium card, multi-currency balances (USD, COP, BTC), instant transfers to frequent contacts and deposits through bank, card, Apple Pay or crypto — with a fully-designed light and dark mode.
features: Premium card with expiry and CVV, gradient finish
Multi-currency balances (USD, COP, BTC) in one view
Instant transfers to frequent contacts
Deposits via bank, card, Apple Pay or crypto
A dedicated asset browser with live search and filters (All assets / Fiat / Trading)
A deposit screen with payment method selection and real-time balance
Fully-designed light and dark mode, not just inverted colors
Smooth navigation between screens with React Navigation

wallet.name: Wallet
wallet.description: A minimal, glassmorphic mobile wallet with a dark, premium fintech-inspired UI. Send and receive money with QR codes, track transaction history and get animated in-app feedback — backed by a simulated API layer.
features: Real-time balance backed by shared global state, with a 7-day balance trend chart
Home screen with one-tap wallet address copy
Send money with recipient, amount and note, with insufficient-balance handling
Receive money via QR code and a copyable wallet address
Transaction history with income/expense styling
Animated toast notifications for confirmations and errors
Simulated API layer to demo loading states without a real backend

kuiper.name: Kuiper (Hércules)
kuiper.description: A strength-training web app built from real gym use: a technique-rich exercise catalog, guided sessions sequenced by biomechanical logic, deterministic weight suggestions from logged history, and an optional Claude-powered session insight — fully bilingual with next-intl.
features: Guided set-by-set workout session with rest timer and technique panel
Deterministic weight suggestions from real history (no AI, no invented data)
Exercise catalog as relational entities: technique, common mistakes, equipment-aware alternatives
Dashboard with last-session summary and recent activity
Progress: total sessions, cumulative volume and per-exercise weight progression
Local backup: export/import the full workout history as JSON
Full ES/EN bilingual support, including the exercise catalog
Optional Claude-powered (Haiku 4.5) session insight, grounded only in real logged data

edstore.name: edStore
edstore.description: A React Native/Expo e-commerce app with a real, session-persisted login and register flow: product browsing across multiple categories, live search and filtering, a persistent shopping cart and a fully custom, themeable design system — all backed by a public REST API, no keys required.
features: Real login and register flow backed by AuthContext, with the session persisted across app restarts
Auth-aware navigation that automatically switches between the auth stack and the main app
Home screen with hero banner, category chips and a live product grid
Explore section with live search, category filtering and sorting by price/rating
Shopping bag with quantity adjustments, live order summary and a cart badge
Cart persisted across app restarts with AsyncStorage
Fully custom, themeable design system built from scratch — no UI library
Powered by a public REST API (Fake Store API) — no backend or API keys needed
